description: Export a scene of MeshInstance3D nodes as a MeshLibrary .res file for use in GridMap. For grid-based 3D tile palettes only, not 2D scenes. Source scene must contain MeshInstance3D children. Pass meshItemNames for a subset, or omit for all. Saves to outputPath, overwriting silently. Returns a plain-text confirmation with the exported item count. Errors if the scene contains no valid meshes. Errors while a Godot runtime session is active on this project; stop_project (or detach_project) clears it.

meshItemNames.description: Names of specific mesh items to export. Omit to export all.

outputPath.description: Output path for the MeshLibrary .res file (relative to project)

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project

name: export_mesh_library
